zh: 老板：「注册公司」，你就是管理员，有 14 天试用
en: Owner: Create a company — you are its admin, with a 14-day trial

zh: 公司代码自己定，员工用它来加入
en: Pick a company code; staff join with it

zh: 员工：「加入公司」，填老板给的公司代码
en: Staff: Join a company with the code from the owner

zh: 忘记密码：填 email 和公司代码，重设链接寄到 email
en: Forgot it? Email and company code: a reset link is emailed

zh: 以后用 email 和密码登录
en: From then on, sign in with email and password

zh: 应用中心：你的配套有的 app 可以打开
en: The app centre: the apps in your plan open

zh: 没买的会锁着，升级就开
en: The rest are locked until you upgrade

zh: 每个 app 上面都可以随时换去另一个
en: Switch to another app from the top of any app
